data_deletion_note: Tenant data is namespaced by tenant_id under per-tenant keys; an integrator/tenant can request deletion and offboarding drops those keys (cryptographic erasure). Install identifiers are tenant-scoped salted hashes that rotate, so there is no durable per-user identity to retain.

data_types.description: Canonical event category (small enum), packed boolean risk bits, and a coarse confidence level (low/medium/high). No raw measurements or free-form payloads.

An HMAC of a per-install key, scoped to the tenant. Lets the server correlate an app instance without ever seeing a raw install id. It is not stable across tenants (no cross-tenant fingerprint) and rotates, so it cannot be used to track a person across apps or sites.
Optional coarse geography (country/region only, never precise location). Omitted entirely unless the tenant's privacy policy enables it; off by default.

not_collected: Persisted raw IP address (used transiently for edge decisions, never stored raw)
